name: @miorin/dsh-atlas-runtime
description: See running jobs across sessions and choose how the right sidebar opens.

scripts.build:tools: node --input-type=module -e "import { existsSync } from 'node:fs'; const entry = './scripts/aggregate/build.mts'; if (existsSync(entry)) await import(entry)" --
scripts.build: npm run --silent build:tools && node scripts/dsh-aggregate.mjs generate .
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check
scripts.check: npm run --silent build:tools -- --check && node scripts/dsh-aggregate.mjs check .
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run --silent build:tools 1>&2 && node scripts/dsh-aggregate.mjs verify-release . 1>&2
